name: Kenji Tanaka
bio:
Kenji Tanaka's culinary journey began in his grandmother's ramen shop in Osaka, where he learned the importance of fresh ingredients and meticulous preparation. His passion for motorsport ignited during a Formula 1 race broadcasted in his youth. He saw a parallel between the precision of the pit crew and the efficiency needed in a professional kitchen.

After graduating from culinary school, Kenji honed his skills in several high-end restaurants, specializing in fusion cuisine that blended Japanese and Brazilian flavors. This unique expertise made him a perfect fit for FVee Brasil, where he ensures the team is fueled with nutritious and delicious meals that cater to diverse palates. He believes that a well-fed team is a winning team, and his innovative menus are a testament to his dedication.

Kenji is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to create culinary masterpieces even with limited resources. His insistence on locally sourced ingredients not only supports the community but also guarantees the freshest possible flavors, setting him apart in the paddock.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight wave
physical.description: Kenji has a focused look and a wiry build, always appearing ready for action.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with recipe ideas.
Insists on brewing green tea for the team every morning.
Unintentionally uses racing terms when describing cooking processes (e.g., "full throttle" when stirring a sauce).
